description: Browse Books to Scrape, a demo bookshop, and collect the books of a category (title, price, url, category, rating, availability), optionally only those cheaper than a price.

pages.name: home
pages.description: The shop front page with the category list

pages.name: more-pages
pages.description: A book listing whose pager offers a next link

pages.name: category
pages.description: The last (or only) page of a category listing

procedures.description: Open one category of books from the category list in the sidebar.

steps.goal: Click the {category} link in the Books category list in the sidebar. Stop on the {category} listing.

procedures.description: Collect every book of a category (all its pages, no price limit): title, price, link, rating and availability. It opens the category itself and follows every page; once it is verified the whole category is collected and the collection mission is complete.
Internal to collect-category, which runs it for each further page. A mission never needs it directly; do not choose it.

steps.goal: Click the link named "next" in the pager below the book list; it is in view. Never click a category in the sidebar, a book, or Add to basket. You are done when the text of the page shows "Page 2 of 2" or the pager shows a "previous" link.

procedures.description: Collect the books of a category that cost less than a price limit (all its pages): title, price, link, rating and availability. It opens the category itself and follows every page; once it is verified the whole filtered collection is done and the mission is complete.
Internal to collect-category-under, which runs it for each further page. A mission never needs it directly; do not choose it.

steps.goal: Click the link named "next" in the pager below the book list; it is in view. Never click a category in the sidebar, a book, or Add to basket. You are done when the text of the page shows "Page 2 of 2" or the pager shows a "previous" link.
